fact: The Minister of Finance presented to the Council of Ministers the global orientation plan (POG), the master plan for computerising public finance at central, provincial and local level, with an integrated system built around budget, accounting and treasury modules and the revenue, procurement, HR and payroll systems connected through a gateway, aimed within three years.
title: RDC : Vers la mise en oeuvre du Plan de numerisation du systeme de gestion des finances publiques
